system.description:
At the start of a scene, you gain [Cancel (Cold): 20]. When this weapon is used in a [Melee Attack] against a target with the [Nature] or [Fairy] tags, you gain a +3D bonus to the damage roll.

A hatchet said to contain the souls of northern pioneers. Gives the wielder the power to repel cold and fend off the raging fury of nature.

Molten Nail [core material] (50G) + Handaxe (50G) x 2 + [magic catalyst 3] (25G) x 3 + Crafting Cost (85G)
